title: The On Site toggle still saves on an Invoiced work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced On Site Inv Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Inv Co").
  • Work order Inv Co with lead Ana, then invoiced (Finance > Create Invoice) — status Invoiced.
  • List shows the On Site column.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced On Site Inv Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co"). Approve it, set lead Ana, then complete and review it (the line's Complete > Tech Story > Complete Line; then Mark Reviewed > Confirm Review, entering the VIN if asked) and click Finance tab > Create Invoice.
  4. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced On Site" in Search — exactly 1 work order shows: Inv Co, Invoiced, lead Ana, with an On Site toggle in its row. If the toggle is not shown, open Column Selection and look for it; if it cannot be shown, report the case Blocked with that reason. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Invoiced On Site" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click List in the display switcher (tooltip "List").
  4. In the Inv Co row, click the On Site toggle to change it.
  5. Refresh the page and read the On Site value.
  6. Open Inv Co and read Lead Technician and Asset on site.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the change is accepted with no error.
  • Step 5: after the refresh the new On Site value is kept.
  • Step 6: Lead Technician is still Ana Alpha. The new lock on Invoiced work orders does not block the On Site toggle.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (revised 24 Sep 2026, uploaded 8 Oct 2026), section 5 (POST /api/work-orders/change) and Phase 3 browser-walk. Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-N2, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced, Paid, or Imported status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”
  • Tech plan 5 change endpoint: “Re-sending the *current* lead stays a no-op so the asset-on-site toggle keeps working on invoiced work orders.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
